newsitem.title: MALAWI: South Africa urges more open AIDS notification in Africa.
newsitem.headline: South Africa urges more open AIDS notification in Africa.

text.p: Sub-Saharan Africa has the world's highest rates of HIV/AIDS infection but lags behind in efforts to stop its spread, a South African official told a three-day AIDS conference in Malawi on Wednesday.

South Africa's director-general for health, Olive Shisana, told the opening of the European Union-backed meeting that African countries needed to rethink their policies on whether partners of people with HIV had the right to be notified.
But she said any move to open disclosure -- which had been promoted with much success in the United States -- had to be coupled with legislation to prevent discrimination against HIV-positive people.
